text: Hello, this is a courtesy voicemail from Metro Water Authority. Scheduled hydrant flushing is planned for your neighborhood tomorrow, Wednesday, from 8:00 AM to noon. You may notice temporary discoloration or reduced pressure; this is normal and clears after a few minutes of running cold water. No payment or account action is required. For a street-by-street map, visit metrowater.gov/flushing. Thank you.

This is an automated message from Lakeside Credit Union regarding a recent card alert. We temporarily paused an online purchase that looked unusual. We will never ask for your PIN, one-time passcode, or gift card numbers by phone. To review the charge, open the Lakeside app or call the number printed on the back of your card. No further action is needed if you already approved the purchase in the app.

Hi, this is a delivery notice from Regional Parcel Service. Your package is out for delivery today between 2:00 PM and 6:00 PM. If you will not be available, you can reschedule or choose a pickup location at rps.com/tracking using your tracking number from the shipping email. We will not ask you to pay a fee by phone or text. Thank you for using Regional Parcel Service.

Hello, this is Northside Family Clinic calling to remind you of your appointment with Dr. Patel tomorrow at 10:30 AM. Please bring your insurance card and arrive ten minutes early for check-in. If you need to cancel or reschedule, call the clinic at the number listed on your appointment reminder card. This message does not request payment over the phone. We look forward to seeing you.

This is a service update from Harbor Electric. Planned line work on Oak Avenue will briefly interrupt power Thursday night from 11:00 PM to 1:00 AM. Essential medical equipment users should prepare backup power as usual. You do not need to call us unless your outage continues after 1:30 AM. Status updates are posted at harborelectric.com/outages. Thank you for your patience.

This is a public information message from the County Clerk. Early voting for the municipal election begins Monday at listed community centers. Polling hours and acceptable IDs are published at countyclerk.gov/vote. Election workers will never ask for gift cards, wire transfers, or your Social Security number by phone. For official questions, use the contact form on the county website.

Hello parents and guardians, this is an attendance notice from Lincoln Middle School. Classes are cancelled tomorrow due to hazardous road conditions. Regular buses and after-school activities are also cancelled. Please check the district portal for reopening updates. The school will not request remote payment or personal financial information related to this closure. Stay safe and we will see students when roads improve.

Hello, this is a benefits reminder from Summit Health Plan. Your annual wellness visit benefit resets next month and is available at no additional cost under most plans. To schedule with an in-network provider, use the member portal or the phone number on your member ID card. We will not ask you to verify coverage by purchasing cards or sharing banking passwords. Thank you for being a Summit member.

This message is from Crestview Servicing regarding your student loan account ending in 4421. A payment is coming due on the 15th. You can pay through your usual online account or mail a check to the address on your statement. You are not required to pay by prepaid card, cryptocurrency, or wire to an individual. If you need a deferment or repayment options, log in to crestviewservicing.com or call the number on your statement.

Hi, this is a courtesy notice from Pacific Mobile. Your phone will undergo a network upgrade overnight that may cause a short service blip around 2:00 AM local time. Your plan, number, and billing stay the same. We will never call to demand immediate payment to keep your line active or ask you to install remote-access software. Details are in the Pacific Mobile app under Network Notices. Thank you.
